_readme: This file is an OVERLAY, not a roster. Team membership is resolved at run
time from the GitHub team API; this file only says which of those members
are eligible for automatic assignment and what each one knows well.
To change who gets review requests, edit 'eligible' below. Do not edit
SKILL.md - it deliberately contains no names.
Every member of the team is listed, including ineligible ones, so that a
person is never silently absent. Removing someone's entry is not the same
as marking them ineligible: an unlisted team member is reported as
unconfigured on every run until someone decides.
THIS REPOSITORY IS PUBLIC. Keep 'evidence' to a neutral statement of which
areas a person owns, or of the mechanics behind an exclusion. Never record
review statistics, performance comparisons, or anything you would not put

An eligible member counts toward existing_coverage on every PR that already requests them, so listing an account that is auto-requested at scale would mark those PRs already covered and silently suppress the assignments they actually need. ai-skills routes to its other declared owner in the meantime.
